verdict.rationale: Metronome documents importing existing contracts and invoices so customers provisioned elsewhere have one billing history. Its contract-creation API, idempotent retries and custom fields for foreign keys support a scripted, API-driven migration. Payment collection is delegated to Stripe, and nothing covers moving card data, importing from a spreadsheet, or connectors for competing platforms. Missing for 10: PCI-compliant card data transfer, spreadsheet/CSV bulk import, migration tooling for competing platforms, evidence that live subscriptions cut over without customer-visible disruption, independent or hands-on corroboration.
